description: This Java class defines a scheduled task (AutoRetireUsersTask) in the OpenMRS platform that automatically retired users after a specified period of inactivity. It interacts with UserService and global properties to determine when to retire users based on last login time or account creation date.

classes.name: AutoRetireUsersTask
classes.description: A scheduled task that automatically retires users after a set period of inactivity based on global property configuration.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method invoked to perform the retirement process, calling getUsersToRetire and retiring applicable users, with logging and exception handling.

methods.name: getUsersToRetire
methods.description: Retrieves all users and filters out superusers, already retired users, and those whose inactivity exceeds the specified threshold based on last login time or account creation date.

methods.name: userInactivityExceedsDaysToRetire
methods.description: Checks if a user's inactivity period exceeds the configured threshold by comparing last login time or account creation date with the current system time.
